title: Champlain Classic Charters
specs: 25-foot antique replica 1950's style lake boat named Butter
Boat equipped with Bluetooth music system
Captain has 42 years piloting experience and USCG license
Children 12 or under must wear a Personal Flotation Device (PFD) at all times by law; bring your own child-sized PFD or use provided ones
Captain holds an active USCG Captain’s License
Butter boat fits up to 6 passengers plus captain and crew
Peanut boat fits up to 5 passengers
Company can accommodate up to 10 passengers total
includes: Access to multiple yeti coolers to store your drinks or food
New 1600 Watt Exceptional Sounding Bluetooth stereo (bring your playlist!)
Photos of guests taken during the trip
blurb: Guests book private charters on Lake Champlain aboard classic and sport boats. Options include sunset cruises and daytime adventures with water skiing and tubing available. The captain is USCG licensed and photos are taken during the trip.
extraNote: 50% deposit required at booking to confirm reservation · Cancel >14 days before trip: full refund minus $50 booking fee · Cancel 7-14 days before trip: 50% refund of deposit · Cancel <7 days before trip: deposit non-refundable · 3% charge added for credit card payments · If seasickness occurs, can return to dock immediately and refund unused portion · Burlington Boathouse Marina, Right Behind “Splash!”
